description: This file defines authentication-related API routes for user registration, login, and fetching current user info in an Express.js backend. It imports models for User and Activity, middleware for auth, and sets up route handlers for POST /auth/register, POST /auth/login, and GET /auth/me.

classes.name: Router
classes.description: Express.js Router instance used to define route handlers.

methods.name: post('/register')
methods.description: Handles user registration, creates user and activity entries, returns auth token.

methods.name: post('/login')
methods.description: Handles user login, verifies credentials, logs activity, returns auth token.

methods.name: get('/me')
methods.description: Returns current user info based on the auth token.
